serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Good day mister Landlord. What is it this time?
Policewoman: Good afternoon citizen! 
!{{wi}} Police?! Why now?!
Policewoman: Don’t be startled, we only came to ask questions. 
You: Q-questions?
Policeman: Yes, questions! Are ya deaf?
You: N-no…
Policewoman: We received few reports of sightings of suspected unregistered automaton.{{wi}} Or even a sexbot.
Policewoman: Have you sir seen anything like that recently?
H-how should I answer? They are obviously after me! I need to be careful…
